title: Sites
subtitle: Build, preview, and publish from Cognia
empty: Create or select a Site to begin.

desktopOnly.title: Sites requires Cognia Desktop
desktopOnly.description: Builds, provider credentials, and previews stay on the selected local desktop host.

purge.title: Purge managed provider resources?
purge.description: This permanently deletes eligible Cognia-managed resources. Adopted and shared provider resources remain intact and will be reported as preserved.

deleteMetadata.title: Delete Cognia Site metadata?
deleteMetadata.description: This removes the deleted Site, versions, operation history, and preserved-resource report from Cognia. Provider resources are not changed.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Plain values are versioned. Secret values go only to this host's OS keyring.

build.title: Confined build and local preview
build.description: Cognia reads .cognia/hosting.json and runs its argv commands inside the OS sandbox.

versions.wranglerPath: Absolute path to the approved Wrangler binary

operations.title: Operation journal
operations.description: Durable lifecycle events used for crash recovery and provider reconciliation.

access.title: Visitor access
access.description: Authoring permissions stay in Cognia. Visitor policy is reconciled with Cloudflare Access.
access.values: One email, domain, or organization ID per line

domains.title: Custom domains
domains.description: Attach and reconcile Cloudflare Worker custom domains.

observability.title: Provider observability
observability.description: Query Cloudflare Worker logs and request analytics without copying them into another runtime.

provider.title: Cloudflare provider
provider.description: The API token is verified before it is stored in the local OS keyring.

authoring.accountsPlaceholder: One Cognia account ID per line

errors.projectRoot: The selected project has no workspace root.
errors.wranglerRequired: Choose an approved absolute Wrangler binary path.
errors.artifactRequired: The saved version artifact is unavailable.
